name: Ai Suru Tsuma, Misaki no Furin Shouko "Danna to Docchi ga Kimochi Ii?" → "Anata no Hou ga... A, Dame, Mata Icchau...!"
original_name: 愛する妻、美咲の不倫証拠 『旦那とどっちが気持ちいい？』→『貴方の方が…あっ、ダメッ、またイちゃうッ…！』
source:
Misaki, the wife of the protagonist, Yahagi Kouji, leaves for a two-night, three-day trip with a friend.
But the phone she left behind at home keeps ringing—calls from an unknown man, over and over.
Feeling uneasy, Kouji starts digging through Misaki’s room.
What he finds are countless photos of her with another man,
and videos of her having sex with someone he doesn’t know…
Misaki had been cheating on him, right under his nose.

Kouji is thrown into the depths of despair.
Should he try to fix things with his wife?
Pretend he never saw anything and keep living this life?
Or should he destroy them both socially and take his revenge?

…Tonight, you will make a decision.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006573.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公矢作幸司的妻子美咲与朋友外出旅行，行程为三天两夜。
然而，她遗忘在家里的手机不断响起——一个陌生男人一遍又一遍打来电话。
幸司心中不安，开始翻找美咲的房间。
他发现了数不清的照片，妻子与另一个男人亲密地出现在画面里，
还有她与陌生人性交的录像……
原来，美咲一直就在他的眼皮底下出轨。

幸司坠入绝望深渊。
应该设法修复与妻子的关系吗？
还是装作什么也没看见，继续如今的生活？
抑或让两人在社会上身败名裂，彻底展开报复？

……今晚，你将作出决定。
